description: Returns an office associated with a company.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response fields to include. `normal` returns id, address, city, country_code, division, fax, logo, name, phone, state_code, and zip. `extended` additionally returns main_office.

state_code.description: State or region code in ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format.

country_code.description: Country code in ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code of the office.

division.description: Business division associated with the office.

main_office.description: Whether this office is the company's main office. Present when view is `extended`.

id.description: Unique identifier for the logo file.

name.description: Display name of the logo file.

filename.description: Filename of the logo file. Prefer `name`; this field is deprecated.
